lastCompletedStory.title: Thread an issueId through the merge-watch state schema

nextStoryContext: US-002 added issueId?: string to MergeWatchState, stashIssueIdInMergeWatch helper (src/release/merge-watch.ts), and updated read/writeMergeWatchState to parse/re-emit the field. An issueId-only file still returns null from readMergeWatchState (prNumber required), so the sidecar stays inert until the PR is created. US-001's resolveIssueId helper lives at src/issues/resolve-id.ts. US-003 (if present) likely wires stashIssueIdInMergeWatch into the ship flow before PR creation. US-004/US-005 depend on issueId being present in the merged state for the post-merge close path.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure in-house schema change to merge-watch state; no external library exercised.
